`/partners` and everything under it now requires a valid `sol_client` session. Without one, the request redirects to `/client/login`. The change is in [i:/Scratch/_trimtest/T4-A-4/proxy.ts](proxy.ts) and is uncommitted. `tsc` reports no errors in `proxy.ts`. I did not load the route in a browser, because `app/partners` doesn't exist yet. The gate is in the proxy, so any page you add there is covered.

- **Who gets in:** any client who logs in at `/client/login` can open `/partners`, not just one workspace. `/partners` has no slug in its URL, so I checked only that the session is valid. If partners should be owner-only, switch it to the admin cookie, as `/lab` does.
- **Login redirect:** it lands on the plain `/client/login`, so the visitor has to pick a workspace themselves. There's no pre-filled `?c=` like the legacy redirects use.
